message: A farmhouse with two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, two washrooms and a pool — got it, and I've taken the pool as an outdoor one beside the house. Two small things: how many people will live there, and would you like a utility or storage room for farm gear? I'm assuming one home, single storey with 2.50 m ceilings unless you say otherwise.

brief.notes: Farmhouse in Bayern. Client asked for one swimming pool — treated as an outdoor pool on the plot, not an enclosed room. Programme: 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 kitchen, 2 washrooms.

questions.question: How many people will live in the farmhouse?
Would you like a utility or storage room for farm gear and laundry?

assumptions.basis: A farmhouse described as one household — a single home unless you tell me otherwise.
Farmhouses of this size sit comfortably on one floor within your 18 x 24 m plot; say the word and bedrooms can go upstairs instead.
Ceiling 2.50 m — comfortably above the Bayern minimum of 2.40 m, with room for floor build-up.
No mention of step-free or barrier-free living; not required for a single home.
Comfortable everyday minimums for a family farmhouse; adjust any that feel small.
Pools are usually outdoors unless you want an indoor pool hall, which would change the building considerably.
